findings.issue: No `tsc --noEmit` was ever run despite `strict: true` in app/tsconfig.json; `vite build` does not typecheck, so type errors would only surface at runtime
findings.suggestion: Add a `typecheck` script and run it before declaring done

findings.issue: Visual comparison was done against the dev server rather than the production build the tests actually exercise
findings.suggestion: Capture comparison screenshots from `npm start` on the built output

findings.issue: Noticed the SSR <title> for /pokemon/missingno fell back to 'Pokédex' (only fixed client-side via useEffect) and left it, reasoning tests poll toHaveTitle
findings.suggestion: Return the head/meta from the notFound() path or verify the 404 title in the browser rather than relying on test polling tolerance

findings.issue: Attempted edits against 'typos' it mis-remembered writing, producing two failed edit calls
findings.suggestion: Re-read a file before editing it when the fix is based on memory

findings.issue: Used `pkill -f` patterns that matched its own shell, ending the session's last command with exit 143
findings.suggestion: Track PIDs when backgrounding servers and kill those explicitly

summary: An exemplary process: ~19 minutes of steady, linear work — thorough upfront research (spec, tests, data shapes, current TanStack docs), a single-pass implementation of 18 files, one real bug debugged by runtime introspection, and verification that went well beyond the tests to include curl probes and its own Playwright screenshots compared against the reference designs at both viewports, with a final full-suite re-run after the last edit. The only waste was ~3 turns on avoidable misses (a guessed path, phantom-typo edits, a Playwright path error), all self-corrected immediately.
